title: Kota Kinabalu vs Kuching: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Kuching for food, culture, and walkability. Kota Kinabalu for beaches, Mount Kinabalu, and Sipadan diving. Do both if you have 7+ days.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: KK has Tunku Abdul Rahman Marine Park with 5 islands. Kuching has no beaches.

categories.name: Food
categories.summary: Sarawak Laksa and Kolo Mee make Kuching a food destination.

categories.name: Culture
categories.summary: Sarawak Museum, Cultural Village, colonial streets — Kuching wins decisively.

categories.name: Hiking
categories.summary: Mount Kinabalu (4095m) is SE Asia most iconic mountain climb.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Both affordable; KK activities cost much more (Kinabalu permit RM1000+).

categories.name: Walkability
categories.summary: Kuching is compact and walkable; KK is sprawling and car-dependent.

faq.question: Which is better for first-time Borneo visitors?
faq.answer: KK for beaches and adventure, Kuching for food and culture.

faq.question: How to get between KK and Kuching?
faq.answer: Fly AirAsia — 2 hours, RM80-180. No practical overland route.
